You can try traditional Latvian food like 🫛🥓 grey peas with bacon, 🥟 piragi and 🍪 gingerbread, along with steaming cups of mulled wine and Riga Black Balsam. 🎶 There are also live performances, traditional Latvian folk music, carol singing and dancing throughout the festive season.
